"contacts"."email", "contacts"."phone", "contacts"."company_id", "companies"."uuid", "contacts"."owner_id", "contacts"."created_by", "users"."uuid", "contacts"."lifecycle_state", "contacts"."lifecycle_stage", "contacts"."lifecycle_stage_date", "contacts"."previous_lifecycle_stage", "contacts"."previous_lifecycle_stage_date", "contacts"."status", "contacts"."lost_reason", "contacts"."other_lost_reason", "contacts"."won_at", "contacts"."lost_at", "contacts"."lead_score", "contacts"."lead_score_source", "contacts"."lead_score_reasons", "contacts"."lead_scored_at", "contacts"."lead_score_model", "contacts"."whatsapp_subscription_status", EXISTS ( SELECT $6 FROM contact_consent_state cs WHERE cs.org_id = "contacts"."org_id" AND cs.contact_id = "contacts"."id" AND cs.channel = $1 AND cs.purpose = $7 AND cs.state = $8), coalesce((SELECT s.require_consent_for_marketing FROM contact_consent_settings s WHERE s.org_id = "contacts"."org_id"), $9), "contacts"."sms_subscription_status", "contacts"."email_subscription_status", "contacts"."email_confirmed", "contacts"."fax_number", "contacts"."date_of_birth", EXISTS (SELECT $10 FROM contact_privacy_flags pf WHERE pf.org_id = "contacts"."org_id" AND pf.contact_id = "contacts"."id" AND pf.is_minor), GREATEST("contacts"."last_activity_at", ( SELECT max(cv.last_message_at) FROM conversations cv WHERE cv.org_id = "contacts"."org_id" AND cv.contact_id = "contacts"."id" )), "contacts"."uncontacted_since", (SELECT jsonb_build_object($11, t.uuid, $12, t.due_at, $13, au.uuid) FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users au ON au.org_id = t.org_id AND au.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.org_id = "contacts"."org_id" AND t.contact_id = "contacts"."id" AND t.kind = $14 AND t.status = $15), "contacts"."data", "contacts"."timezone", "contacts"."timezone_source", "contacts"."source", "contacts"."is_unsubscribed", "contacts"."is_archived", "contacts"."row_version", "contacts"."created_at", "contacts"."updated_at" from "contacts" left join "users" on ("users"."org_id" = "contacts"."org_id" and "users"."id" = "contacts"."owner_id") left join "companies" on ("companies"."org_id" = "contacts"."org_id" and "companies"."id" = "contacts"."company_id") where ("contacts"."org_id" = $2 and "contacts"."id" = $3)

select "contacts"."id", "contacts"."uuid", to_char("contacts"."created_at" at time zone $4, $5), "contacts"."display_id", "contacts"."name", "contacts"."first_name", "contacts"."last_name", "contacts"."email", "contacts"."phone", "contacts"."company_id", "companies"."uuid", "contacts"."owner_id", "contacts"."created_by", "users"."uuid", "contacts"."lifecycle_state", "contacts"."lifecycle_stage", "contacts"."lifecycle_stage_date", "contacts"."previous_lifecycle_stage", "contacts"."previous_lifecycle_stage_date", "contacts"."status", "contacts"."lost_reason", "contacts"."other_lost_reason", "contacts"."won_at", "contacts"."lost_at", "contacts"."lead_score", "contacts"."lead_score_source", "contacts"."lead_score_reasons", "contacts"."lead_scored_at", "contacts"."lead_score_model", "contacts"."whatsapp_subscription_status", EXISTS ( SELECT $6 FROM contact_consent_state cs WHERE cs.org_id = "contacts"."org_id" AND cs.contact_id = "contacts"."id" AND cs.channel = $1 AND cs.purpose = $7 AND cs.state = $8), coalesce((SELECT s.require_consent_for_marketing FROM contact_consent_settings s WHERE s.org_id = "contacts"."org_id"), $9), "contacts"."sms_subscription_status", "contacts"."email_subscription_status", "contacts"."email_confirmed", "contacts"."fax_number", "contacts"."date_of_birth", EXISTS (SELECT $10 FROM contact_privacy_flags pf WHERE pf.org_id = "contacts"."org_id" AND pf.contact_id = "contacts"."id" AND pf.is_minor), GREATEST("contacts"."last_activity_at", ( SELECT max(cv.last_message_at) FROM conversations cv WHERE cv.org_id = "contacts"."org_id" AND cv.contact_id = "contacts"."id" )), "contacts"."uncontacted_since", (SELECT jsonb_build_object($11, t.uuid, $12, t.due_at, $13, au.uuid) FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users au ON au.org_id = t.org_id AND au.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.org_id = "contacts"."org_id" AND t.contact_id = "contacts"."id" AND t.kind = $14 AND t.status = $15), "contacts"."data", "contacts"."timezone", "contacts"."timezone_source", "contacts"."source", "contacts"."is_unsubscribed", "contacts"."is_archived", "contacts"."row_version", "contacts"."created_at", "contacts"."updated_at" from "contacts" left join "users" on ("users"."org_id" = "contacts"."org_id" and "users"."id" = "contacts"."owner_id") left join "companies" on ("companies"."org_id" = "contacts"."org_id" and "companies"."id" = "contacts"."company_id") where ("contacts"."org_id" = $2 and "contacts"."uuid" = $3)

SELECT a.id, to_char(a.at AT TIME ZONE $5, $6) AS at_text, a.actor_id, a.actor_type, a.module, a.record_id, a.action, a.request_id, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.delta) = $7 THEN ARRAY(SELECT k FROM jsonb_object_keys(a.delta) k WHERE k <> $8 ORDER BY k) ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END AS changed_fields, a.delta #>> $9 AS session_uuid, u.uuid::text AS user_uuid, u.full_name AS user_name, ak.name AS key_name, a.delta FROM audit_log a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = a.org_id AND u.id = a.actor_id AND a.actor_type = $10 LEFT JOIN api_keys ak ON ak.org_id = a.org_id AND ak.id = a.actor_id AND a.actor_type = $11 WHERE a.org_id = $1 AND a.at >= $2::timestamptz AND a.at < $3::timestamptz ORDER BY a.at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT $4
delete from "contacts" where ("contacts"."org_id" = $1 and "contacts"."id" = $2) returning "id"
SELECT DISTINCT a.module, a.action FROM audit_log a WHERE a.org_id = $1 AND a.at >= $2::timestamptz AND a.at < $3::timestamptz
update "contacts" set "updated_by" = $1 where ("contacts"."org_id" = $2 and "contacts"."id" = $3 and "contacts"."row_version" = $4) returning "id"
INSERT INTO tags (org_id, name, color) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (org_id, name) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, uuid
SELECT settings ->> $2 AS currency, settings ->> $3 AS timezone FROM organizations WHERE id = $1

SELECT u.uuid::text AS id, u.full_name AS name FROM users u WHERE u.org_id = $1 AND u.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a.actor_id FROM audit_log a WHERE a.org_id = $2 AND a.actor_type = $5 AND a.actor_id IS NOT NULL AND a.at >= $3::timestamptz AND a.at < $4::timestamptz) ORDER BY u.full_name, u.id
SELECT timezone FROM user_profiles WHERE org_id = $1 AND user_id = $2

SELECT * FROM ( (SELECT $6::text AS kind, a.type AS type, a.created_at AS at, d.title AS subject, d.uuid AS subject_uuid, u.uuid AS actor_uuid, u.full_name AS actor_name, a.meta -> $7 ->> $8 AS from_name, a.meta -> $9 ->> $10 AS to_name FROM deal_activities a JOIN deals d ON d.org_id = a.org_id AND d.id = a.deal_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = a.org_id AND u.id = a.user_id WHERE d.org_id = $1 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT $11::text AS kind, ca.activity_type AS type, ca.occurred_at AS at, c.name AS subject, c.uuid AS subject_uuid, u.uuid AS actor_uuid, u.full_name AS actor_name, $12::text AS from_name, $13::text AS to_name FROM contact_activities ca JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = ca.org_id AND c.id = ca.contact_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = ca.org_id AND u.id = ca.actor_id WHERE ca.org_id = $3 ORDER BY ca.occurred_at DESC LIMIT $4) ) feed ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT $5
SELECT file_gz FROM contact_consent_exports WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND status = $3 AND expires_at > now()

SELECT i.currency, coalesce(sum(greatest(i.total_minor - i.paid_minor - i.credited_minor, $3)), $4)::text AS outstanding, coalesce(sum(greatest(i.total_minor - i.paid_minor - i.credited_minor, $5)) FILTER (WHERE i.due_date < $1::date), $6)::text AS overdue, count(*)::int AS invoices FROM invoices i WHERE i.org_id = $2 AND i.status = $7 AND i.payment_status <> $8 GROUP BY i.currency ORDER BY i.currency

SELECT currency, bucket, sum(bal)::text AS amount, count(*)::int AS invoices FROM ( SELECT i.currency, (i.total_minor - i.paid_minor - i.credited_minor) AS bal, CASE WHEN dpd <= $3 THEN $4 WHEN dpd <= $5 THEN $6 WHEN dpd <= $7 THEN $8 WHEN dpd <= $9 THEN $10 ELSE $11 END AS bucket FROM (SELECT i.*, ((now() AT TIME ZONE $1)::date - coalesce(i.due_date, i.issue_date)) AS dpd FROM invoices i) i WHERE i.org_id = $2 AND i.status = $12 AND i.payment_status <> $13 AND i.total_minor > i.paid_minor + i.credited_minor ) b GROUP BY currency, bucket

SELECT c.source, count(*)::int AS leads, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ds.n > $5))::int AS with_deal, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ds.won_n > $6))::int AS with_won FROM contacts c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::int AS n, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status = $7))::int AS won_n FROM deals d WHERE d.org_id = c.org_id AND d.contact_id = c.id ) ds ON $8 WHERE c.org_id = $1 AND c.lifecycle_state = $9 AND NOT c.is_archived AND c.source IS NOT NULL AND c.created_at >= $2::timestamptz AND c.created_at < $3::timestamptz GROUP BY c.source ORDER BY leads DESC, c.source LIMIT $4

SELECT user_agent, count(*)::int AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now())::int AS active FROM auth_sessions WHERE org_id = $1 AND created_at >= $2::timestamptz AND created_at < $3::timestamptz GROUP BY user_agent

SELECT t.uuid, t.name, t.color, (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.id) FROM ( SELECT ct.contact_id AS id FROM contact_tags ct WHERE ct.org_id = t.org_id AND ct.tag_id = t.id UNION SELECT c.contact_id FROM conversation_tag cvt JOIN conversations c ON c.org_id = cvt.org_id AND c.id = cvt.conversation_id WHERE cvt.org_id = t.org_id AND cvt.tag_id = t.id AND c.contact_id IS NOT NULL ) x)::int AS members FROM tags t WHERE t.org_id = $1 ORDER BY t.name

SELECT d.stage_id, d.currency, count(*)::int AS n, coalesce(sum(d.value_minor), $4)::text AS total, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.expected_close_date < $1::date))::int AS late FROM deals d WHERE d.org_id = $2 AND d.pipeline_id = $3 AND d.status = $5 GROUP BY d.stage_id, d.currency
WITH u AS (UPDATE "audit_log" SET "delta" = $3 WHERE org_id = $1 AND (module = $4 AND record_id = ANY($2::bigint[])) RETURNING $5) SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM u

SELECT p.currency, CASE WHEN p.paid_at >= $1::timestamptz THEN $5 ELSE $6 END AS win, coalesce(sum(p.amount_minor), $7)::text AS total FROM payments p LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.org_id = p.org_id AND i.id = p.invoice_id WHERE p.org_id = $2 AND p.kind = $8 AND p.paid_at >= $3::timestamptz AND p.paid_at < $4::timestamptz GROUP BY p.currency, win

SELECT u.uuid AS owner_uuid, u.full_name AS owner_name, d.currency, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status = $12 AND d.won_at >= $1::timestamptz AND d.won_at < $2::timestamptz))::int AS won_n, coalesce(sum(d.value_minor) FILTER (WHERE d.status = $13 AND d.won_at >= $3::timestamptz AND d.won_at < $4::timestamptz), $14)::text AS won_total, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status = $15 AND d.lost_at >= $5::timestamptz AND d.lost_at < $6::timestamptz))::int AS lost_n, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status = $16))::int AS open_n FROM deals d LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = d.org_id AND u.id = d.owner_user_id WHERE d.org_id = $7 AND (d.status = $17 OR (d.status = $18 AND d.won_at >= $8::timestamptz AND d.won_at < $9::timestamptz) OR (d.status = $19 AND d.lost_at >= $10::timestamptz AND d.lost_at < $11::timestamptz)) GROUP BY u.uuid, u.full_name, d.currency

COPY ( select id, org_id, aggregate_module, aggregate_id, event_type, status, created_at, processed_at, round ( ( extract ( epoch from ( processed_at-created_at ) ) *1000 ) ::numeric,2 ) as lag_ms from event_outbox order by id ) TO STDOUT csv header
select set_config($1, $2, $3)
SELECT ensure_monthly_partition( $1::regclass, (date_trunc($3, now()) + ($2 || $4)::interval)::date )
SELECT enabled, apply_to_imports FROM assignment_settings WHERE org_id = $1

SELECT d.status AS kind, CASE WHEN CASE d.status WHEN $7 THEN d.won_at ELSE d.lost_at END >= $1::timestamptz THEN $8 ELSE $9 END AS win, d.currency, count(*)::int AS n, coalesce(sum(d.value_minor), $10)::text AS total, coalesce(sum(extract($11 FROM (CASE d.status WHEN $12 THEN d.won_at ELSE d.lost_at END - d.created_at)) / $13), $14)::float8 AS days FROM deals d WHERE d.org_id = $2 AND ( (d.status = $15 AND d.won_at >= $3::timestamptz AND d.won_at < $4::timestamptz) OR (d.status = $16 AND d.lost_at >= $5::timestamptz AND d.lost_at < $6::timestamptz) ) GROUP BY d.status, win, d.currency
SELECT $2 FROM ONLY "public"."organizations" x WHERE "id" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) $1 FOR KEY SHARE OF x
UPDATE wpcampaigns SET sent_count = $1, delivered_count = $2, read_count = $3, responded_count = $4, clicked_count = $5, failed_count = $6 WHERE org_id = $7 AND id = $8

SELECT t.id, t.uuid, t.name::text AS name, t.color, t.description, t.row_version, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM conversation_tag x WHERE x.org_id = t.org_id AND x.tag_id = t.id) AS conversation_count FROM tags t WHERE t.org_id = $1 ORDER BY t.name
INSERT INTO auth_sessions (org_id, user_id, remember, mfa_verified, ip, user_agent, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::inet, $6, now() + make_interval(secs => $7)) RETURNING uuid
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM invoices i WHERE i.org_id = $1 AND i.payment_status = $4 AND i.paid_at >= $2::timestamptz AND i.paid_at < $3::timestamptz

COPY ( select id, org_id, aggregate_module, aggregate_id, event_type, status, created_at, processed_at, round ( ( extract ( $1 from ( processed_at-created_at ) ) *$2 ) ::numeric,$3 ) as lag_ms from event_outbox order by id ) TO STDOUT csv header

SELECT a.at, a.module, u.full_name AS by_name, a.delta, e.uuid AS file_id, e.byte_size AS file_bytes, e.expires_at, e.created_by AS file_owner FROM audit_log a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.actor_type = $3 AND u.org_id = a.org_id AND u.id = a.actor_id LEFT JOIN contact_exports e ON e.org_id = a.org_id AND e.expires_at > now() AND e.uuid::text = a.delta -> $4 ->> $5 WHERE a.org_id = $1 AND a.module IN ($6, $7) AND a.action = $8 ORDER BY a.at DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT d.status AS kind, d.currency, to_char(date_trunc($1, CASE d.status WHEN $8 THEN d.won_at ELSE d.lost_at END AT TIME ZONE $2), $9) AS start, count(*)::int AS n, coalesce(sum(d.value_minor), $10)::text AS total FROM deals d WHERE d.org_id = $3 AND ( (d.status = $11 AND d.won_at >= $4::timestamptz AND d.won_at < $5::timestamptz) OR (d.status = $12 AND d.lost_at >= $6::timestamptz AND d.lost_at < $7::timestamptz) ) GROUP BY d.status, d.currency, start

SELECT d.stage_id, d.currency, count(*)::int AS n, coalesce(sum(d.value_minor), $3)::text AS total, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.expected_close_date < $1::date))::int AS late FROM deals d WHERE d.org_id = $2 AND d.status = $4 GROUP BY d.stage_id, d.currency
select "id", "phone", "country_code", "created_at" from "contacts" where ("contacts"."org_id" = $1 and "contacts"."id" > $2) order by "contacts"."id" asc limit $3

SELECT p.uuid, p.amount_minor::text AS amount, p.currency, p.paid_at, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, c.name AS contact_name FROM payments p LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.org_id = p.org_id AND i.id = p.invoice_id LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = p.org_id AND c.id = p.contact_id WHERE p.org_id = $1 AND p.kind = $3 ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT count(*)::int AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (NOT "contacts"."is_unsubscribed" AND (EXISTS ( SELECT $6 FROM contact_consent_state cs WHERE cs.org_id = "contacts"."org_id" AND cs.contact_id = "contacts"."id" AND cs.channel = $1 AND cs.purpose = $7 AND cs.state = $8) OR (lower(btrim(coalesce("contacts"."whatsapp_subscription_status", $9))) = $10 AND NOT coalesce((SELECT s.require_consent_for_marketing FROM contact_consent_settings s WHERE s.org_id = "contacts"."org_id"), $11)))))::int AS subscribed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "contacts"."is_unsubscribed")::int AS unsubscribed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "contacts"."import_job_id" IS NOT NULL)::int AS imported, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "contacts"."uncontacted_since" IS NOT NULL)::int AS uncontacted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "contacts"."id" IN ( SELECT t.contact_id FROM tasks t WHERE t.org_id = $2 AND t.kind = $12 AND t.status = $13 ))::int AS with_follow_up, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "contacts"."id" NOT IN ( SELECT m.contact_id FROM contact_group_members m WHERE m.org_id = $3 ))::int AS no_group FROM "contacts" WHERE ("contacts"."org_id" = $4 and "contacts"."is_archived" = $5)

SELECT t.id, t.uuid, to_char(t.created_at at time zone $5, $6) AS created_at_iso, to_char(coalesce(t.due_at, $7::timestamptz) at time zone $8, $9) AS due_key, to_char(coalesce(t.done_at, $10::timestamptz) at time zone $11, $12) AS done_key, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.title, t.notes, t.priority, t.status, t.source, t.kind, t.due_at, t.done_at, t.reminded_at, t.row_version, CASE WHEN t.status <> $13 THEN $14 WHEN t.due_at IS NULL THEN $15 WHEN t.due_at < now() THEN $16 WHEN t.due_at < ((date_trunc($17, now() AT TIME ZONE $1) + interval $18) AT TIME ZONE $2) THEN $19 ELSE $20 END AS bucket, t.assignee_id, au.uuid AS assignee_uuid, au.full_name AS assignee_name, t.created_by, cu.uuid AS created_by_uuid, cu.full_name AS created_by_name, t.contact_id, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, c.name AS contact_name, t.deal_id, dl.uuid AS deal_uuid, dl.title AS deal_title, t.company_id, co.uuid AS company_uuid, co.name AS company_name, t.outcome_id, oc.uuid AS outcome_uuid, oc.name AS outcome_name, oc.is_active AS outcome_active, t.task_type_id, tto.uuid AS task_type_uuid, tto.key AS task_type_key, tto.name AS task_type_name, tto.is_system AS task_type_system, tta.key AS task_type_activity, (tto.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS task_type_removed FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users au ON au.org_id = t.org_id AND au.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN users cu ON cu.org_id = t.org_id AND cu.id = t.created_by LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = t.org_id AND c.id = t.contact_id LEFT JOIN deals dl ON dl.org_id = t.org_id AND dl.id = t.deal_id LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.org_id = t.org_id AND co.id = t.company_id LEFT JOIN task_outcomes oc ON oc.org_id = t.org_id AND oc.id = t.outcome_id LEFT JOIN activity_type_options tto ON tto.org_id = t.org_id AND tto.id = t.task_type_id LEFT JOIN activity_types tta ON tta.org_id = tto.org_id AND tta.id = tto.activity_type_id WHERE t.org_id = $3 AND t.id = $4

SELECT id, CASE WHEN is_published AND published_flow_data IS NOT NULL THEN published_trigger_config ELSE trigger_config END AS trigger_config FROM flows WHERE org_id = $1 AND is_published AND is_active AND CASE WHEN is_published AND published_flow_data IS NOT NULL THEN published_trigger_kind ELSE trigger_kind END = $2 ORDER BY id

SELECT u.status, s.email_verified_at, s.force_password_change, s.password_changed_at, COALESCE(s.mfa_enabled, $3) AS mfa_enabled, EXISTS ( SELECT $4 FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.org_id = ur.org_id AND r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.org_id = u.org_id AND ur.user_id = u.id AND r.system_key IN ($5, $6) ) AS is_admin, (o.settings ->> $7) = u.uuid::text AS is_owner FROM users u JOIN organizations o ON o.id = u.org_id LEFT JOIN user_security s ON s.org_id = u.org_id AND s.user_id = u.id WHERE u.org_id = $1 AND u.id = $2

UPDATE audit_log_exports SET status = $8, file_name = $1, file_gz = $2, file_bytes = $3, row_count = $4, completed_at = now(), expires_at = $5, error = $9 WHERE org_id = $6 AND id = $7 AND status = $10
select count(*) from contacts

SELECT c.name, c.first_name AS "firstName", c.last_name AS "lastName", c.middle_name AS "middleName", c.title, c.phone, c.country_code AS "countryCode", c.email::text AS email, c.address, c.language, c.data, coalesce((SELECT string_agg(g.name, $2 ORDER BY g.name) FROM contact_group_members m JOIN contact_groups g ON g.org_id = m.org_id AND g.id = m.group_id WHERE m.org_id = c.org_id AND m.contact_id = c.id), $3) AS groups FROM contacts c WHERE c.org_id = $1 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT $4

SELECT c.id, c.uuid, c.display_id, c.name, lower(c.name) AS name_key, to_char(c.created_at at time zone $3, $4) AS created_at_iso, $5::text AS sort_key, c.domain, c.email::text AS email, c.phone, c.industry, c.size_range, c.address, c.notes, c.data, c.owner_id, ou.uuid AS owner_uuid, ou.full_name AS owner_name, c.created_by, cu.uuid AS created_by_uuid, cu.full_name AS created_by_name, c.row_version, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM companies c LEFT JOIN users ou ON ou.org_id = c.org_id AND ou.id = c.owner_id LEFT JOIN users cu ON cu.org_id = c.org_id AND cu.id = c.created_by WHERE c.org_id = $1 AND c.id = $2
SELECT id, checksum, applied_at FROM platform_migration_ledger()

INSERT INTO user_security (org_id, user_id, last_login_at, email_verified_at, password_changed_at) VALUES ($1, $2, now(), CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN now() END, CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN now() END) ON CONFLICT (org_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET last_login_at = now(), email_verified_at = COALESCE(user_security.email_verified_at, EXCLUDED.email_verified_at), password_changed_at = COALESCE(user_security.password_changed_at, EXCLUDED.password_changed_at)
SELECT file_gz, file_name FROM audit_log_exports WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND status = $3 AND expires_at > now()
SELECT contact_id FROM contact_identities WHERE org_id = $1 AND kind = $2 AND value = $3 LIMIT $4
SELECT settings ->> $2 AS timezone FROM organizations WHERE id = $1
SELECT tm.team_id FROM team_members tm WHERE tm.org_id = p_org AND tm.user_id = p_user AND tm.is_primary LIMIT $3

SELECT d.*, to_char(d.created_at at time zone $3, $4) AS created_at_iso, to_char(d.valid_until, $5) AS valid_until_text, ou.uuid AS owner_uuid, ou.full_name AS owner_name, cu.uuid AS created_by_uuid, cu.full_name AS created_by_name, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, c.name AS contact_name, co.uuid AS company_uuid, co.name AS company_name, dl.uuid AS deal_uuid, dl.title AS deal_title, inv.uuid AS invoice_uuid, src.uuid AS duplicated_from_uuid FROM sales_docs d LEFT JOIN users ou ON ou.org_id = d.org_id AND ou.id = d.owner_id LEFT JOIN users cu ON cu.org_id = d.org_id AND cu.id = d.created_by LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = d.org_id AND c.id = d.contact_id LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.org_id = d.org_id AND co.id = d.company_id LEFT JOIN deals dl ON dl.org_id = d.org_id AND dl.id = d.deal_id LEFT JOIN invoices inv ON inv.org_id = d.org_id AND inv.id = d.invoice_id LEFT JOIN sales_docs src ON src.org_id = d.org_id AND src.id = d.duplicated_from_id WHERE d.org_id = $1 ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT $2
SELECT plan FROM organizations WHERE id = $1

SELECT t.uuid AS team_uuid, t.name AS team_name, u.uuid AS user_uuid, u.full_name FROM teams t LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON tm.org_id = t.org_id AND tm.team_id = t.id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = tm.org_id AND u.id = tm.user_id WHERE t.org_id = $1 AND t.receives_conversations ORDER BY t.sort, lower(t.name), t.id, lower(u.full_name)

SELECT p.features, p.limits, ma.slug AS app_slug, (SELECT wi.status FROM workspace_app_installations wi WHERE wi.org_id = a.org_id AND wi.app_id = p.marketplace_app_id) AS install FROM workspace_addons a JOIN plans p ON p.id = a.package_id LEFT JOIN marketplace_apps ma ON ma.id = p.marketplace_app_id WHERE a.org_id = $1 AND a.status = $2 AND ( a.ends_at IS NULL OR a.ends_at > now() OR EXISTS ( SELECT $3 FROM subscriptions sb WHERE sb.org_id = a.org_id AND sb.workspace_addon_id = a.id AND sb.kind = $4 AND sb.status IN ($5, $6) AND a.ends_at > now() - make_interval(days => $7)))

SELECT t.id, t.uuid, t.name, t.slug, t.color, t.description, t.assignment_strategy, t.is_default, t.sort, t.device_ids, t.parent_team_id, pt.uuid AS parent_uuid, (WITH RECURSIVE up AS ( SELECT x.id, x.parent_team_id, $3 AS d FROM teams x WHERE x.org_id = t.org_id AND x.id = t.id UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.parent_team_id, up.d + $4 FROM teams p JOIN up ON p.org_id = t.org_id AND p.id = up.parent_team_id WHERE up.d < $5) SELECT max(d) FROM up) AS depth, t.lead_user_id, lu.uuid AS lead_uuid, lu.full_name AS lead_name, t.receives_conversations, t.receives_records, t.is_scope_boundary, t.business_hours, t.timezone, du.uuid AS default_assignee_uuid, du.full_name AS default_assignee_name, t.row_version, t.created_at, to_char(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE $6, $7) AS created_at_iso FROM teams t LEFT JOIN teams pt ON pt.org_id = t.org_id AND pt.id = t.parent_team_id LEFT JOIN users lu ON lu.org_id = t.org_id AND lu.id = t.lead_user_id AND lu.status <> $8 LEFT JOIN users du ON du.org_id = t.org_id AND du.id = t.default_assignee_id AND du.status <> $9 WHERE t.org_id = $1 AND t.uuid = $2::uuid

SELECT t.*, u.uuid AS host_uuid, u.full_name AS host_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM appointments a WHERE a.org_id = t.org_id AND a.booking_type_id = t.id) AS appointments_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM appointments a WHERE a.org_id = t.org_id AND a.booking_type_id = t.id AND a.status IN ($2, $3) AND a.starts_at > now()) AS upcoming_count FROM booking_types t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = t.org_id AND u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.org_id = $1 ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.id DESC LIMIT $4
SELECT slug FROM legal_pages WHERE is_published AND slug IN ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ORDER BY sort

SELECT uc.id, uc.kind, uc.units, uc.created_at::text AS cursor_at, to_char(uc.created_at AT TIME ZONE $6, $7) AS created_iso, uc.wamid, uc.status, uc.billing_mode, uc.free_reason, uc.source, uc.provider, uc.to_country, uc.category, COALESCE(uc.template_name, legacy.template_name) AS template_name, COALESCE(uc.subject_name, legacy.subject_name) AS subject_name, uc.shortfall_credits, to_char(uc.refunded_at AT TIME ZONE $8, $9) AS refunded_iso, (-ch.amount)::text AS charged_exact, rf.amount::text AS refunded_exact FROM usage_charges uc LEFT JOIN wallet_transactions ch ON ch.org_id = uc.org_id AND ch.id = uc.wallet_tx_id LEFT JOIN wallet_transactions rf ON rf.org_id = uc.org_id AND rf.id = uc.refund_tx_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT n.template_name, n.subject_name FROM ( SELECT t.template_name, b.name AS subject_name, $10 AS pref FROM broadcast_contacts bc JOIN broadcasts b ON b.org_id = bc.org_id AND b.id = bc.broadcast_id LEFT JOIN wa_templates t ON t.org_id = b.org_id AND t.id = b.template_id WHERE bc.org_id = uc.org_id AND bc.whatsapp_message_id = uc.wamid UNION ALL SELECT t.template_name, w.campaign_name, $11 FROM wp_campaign_contacts cc JOIN wpcampaigns w ON w.org_id = cc.org_id AND w.id = cc.campaign_id LEFT JOIN wa_templates t ON t.org_id = w.org_id AND t.id = w.template_id WHERE cc.org_id = uc.org_id AND cc.whatsapp_message_id = uc.wamid ) n ORDER BY n.pref LIMIT $12 ) legacy ON uc.kind = $13 AND (uc.template_name IS NULL OR uc.subject_name IS NULL) WHERE uc.org_id = $1 AND (uc.currency = $2 OR (uc.currency IS NULL AND $3 = $4)) ORDER BY uc.created_at DESC, uc.id DESC LIMIT $5
SELECT provider, api_key, default_model FROM admin_ai_keys WHERE is_active AND provider = $1
SELECT id, uuid, name, system_key FROM roles WHERE org_id = $1 ORDER BY name

SELECT p.id, p.uuid, p.created_at, to_char(p.created_at at time zone $3, $4) AS created_at_iso, p.kind, p.amount_minor::text, p.currency, p.method, p.source, p.paid_at, to_char(p.paid_at at time zone $5, $6) AS paid_at_iso, p.reference, p.note, p.receipt_number, p.invoice_id, i.uuid AS invoice_uuid, i.invoice_number, p.contact_id, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, c.name AS contact_name, p.refund_of_id, rp.uuid AS refund_of_uuid, rp.receipt_number AS refund_of_receipt, (SELECT coalesce(sum(-r.amount_minor), $7) FROM payments r WHERE r.org_id = p.org_id AND r.refund_of_id = p.id)::text AS refunded_minor, p.recorded_by, u.uuid AS recorded_by_uuid, u.full_name AS recorded_by_name FROM payments p LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.org_id = p.org_id AND i.id = p.invoice_id LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = p.org_id AND c.id = p.contact_id LEFT JOIN payments rp ON rp.org_id = p.org_id AND rp.id = p.refund_of_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = p.org_id AND u.id = p.recorded_by WHERE p.org_id = $1 AND p.uuid = $2::uuid

SELECT p.id, p.uuid, p.title, p.slug, p.excerpt, p.body, p.featured_image, p.tags, p.author_name, p.status, p.published_at, p.views, p.is_featured, p.meta_title, p.meta_description, p.meta_keywords, p.og_image, p.canonical_url, p.noindex, p.row_version, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (p.status = $1 AND (p.published_at IS NULL OR p.published_at <= now())) AS live, COALESCE(p.published_at, p.created_at) AS sort_at, to_char((COALESCE(p.published_at, p.created_at)) at time zone $2, $3) AS sort_iso, c.uuid AS cat_uuid, c.name AS cat_name, c.slug AS cat_slug FROM blog_posts p LEFT JOIN blog_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = $4 AND (p.published_at IS NULL OR p.published_at <= now()) AND p.is_featured ORDER BY COALESCE(p.published_at, p.created_at) DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT $5

SELECT provider, default_model, extra_config FROM admin_ai_keys WHERE is_active AND provider <> $1 ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT e.id, e.uuid, e.contact_id, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, e.channel, e.purpose, e.action, e.source, e.evidence, u.uuid AS actor_uuid, u.full_name AS actor_name, e.note, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at FROM contact_consent_events e LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = e.org_id AND c.id = e.contact_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = e.org_id AND u.id = e.actor_user_id WHERE e.org_id = $1 ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT o.settings->>$2 AS onboarding, (SELECT upper(btrim(x.billing_country)) FROM orders x WHERE x.org_id = o.id AND x.status = $3 AND btrim(coalesce(x.billing_country, $4)) <> $5 ORDER BY x.paid_at DESC NULLS LAST, x.id DESC LIMIT $6) AS billing FROM organizations o WHERE o.id = $1

SELECT b.uuid, b.name, coalesce(b.updated_at, b.created_at) AS at, count(bc.id)::int AS recipients, count(bc.id) FILTER (WHERE (bc.status IN ($3, $4) OR bc.delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR bc.read_at IS NOT NULL))::int AS delivered, count(bc.id) FILTER (WHERE (bc.status = $5 OR bc.read_at IS NOT NULL))::int AS read, count(bc.id) FILTER (WHERE bc.status = $6)::int AS failed FROM broadcasts b LEFT JOIN broadcast_contacts bc ON bc.org_id = b.org_id AND bc.broadcast_id = b.id WHERE b.org_id = $1 AND b.status IN ($7, $8) GROUP BY b.id, b.uuid, b.name, b.updated_at, b.created_at ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT $2

w.duration_sec > $3)), $4) AS avg_sec, coalesce(sum(w.duration_sec), $5) AS total_sec FROM (SELECT $6::text AS source, w.org_id, w.id AS row_id, w.uuid, w.direction, w.status, w.duration_sec, w.end_reason, w.from_phone, w.to_phone, w.started_at, w.answered_at, w.ended_at, w.handler_type, w.handler_user_id, w.contact_id, w.wa_provider_config_id, (w.recording_path IS NOT NULL) AS has_recording, (CASE WHEN w.status = $7 THEN $8 WHEN w.status = $9 AND w.duration_sec > $10 THEN $11 WHEN w.status = $12 AND upper(coalesce(w.end_reason, $13)) IN ($14, $15) THEN $16 WHEN w.status = $17 THEN $18 ELSE $19 END) AS log_status, (w.status = $20 AND w.duration_sec > $21) AS is_answered, (w.direction = $22 AND w.status IN ($23, $24) AND w.duration_sec <= $25) AS is_missed, $26::text AS outcome, $27::text AS notes, $28::text AS number_label FROM wa_calls w UNION ALL SELECT e.source, e.org_id, e.id AS row_id, e.uuid, CASE e.direction WHEN $29 THEN $30 ELSE $31 END AS direction, CASE WHEN e.outcome IN ($32, $33) THEN $34 ELSE $35 END AS status, e.duration_sec, CASE e.outcome WHEN $36 THEN $37 WHEN $38 THEN $39 WHEN $40 THEN $41 WHEN $42 THEN $43 WHEN $44 THEN $45 ELSE $46 END AS end_reason, CASE e.direction WHEN $47 THEN regexp_replace(coalesce(e.customer_phone, $48), $49, $50, $51) ELSE regexp_replace(coalesce(e.our_phone, $52), $53, $54, $55) END AS from_phone, CASE e.direction WHEN $56 THEN regexp_replace(coalesce(e.our_phone, $57), $58, $59, $60) ELSE regexp_replace(coalesce(e.customer_phone, $61), $62, $63, $64) END AS to_phone, e.started_at, $65::timestamptz AS answered_at, e.started_at + make_interval(secs => e.duration_sec) AS ended_at, CASE WHEN e.handler_user_id IS NULL THEN $66 ELSE $67 END AS handler_type, e.handler_user_id, e.contact_id, $68::bigint AS wa_provider_config_id, (e.recording_ref IS NOT NULL) AS has_recording, CASE e.outcome WHEN $69 THEN $70 WHEN $71 THEN $72 WHEN $73 THEN $74 WHEN $75 THEN $76 ELSE $77 END AS log_status, w.org_id = $1 AND w.started_at >= $2::timestamptz

WITH RECURSIVE chain AS ( SELECT tm.is_primary, t.id AS start_team, t.id AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.parent_team_id, t.lead_user_id, $6 AS hop, t.sort AS sort FROM team_members tm JOIN teams t ON t.org_id = tm.org_id AND t.id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.org_id = $1 AND tm.user_id = $2 UNION ALL SELECT c.is_primary, c.start_team, p.id, c.team_name, p.parent_team_id, p.lead_user_id, c.hop + $7, c.sort FROM chain c JOIN teams p ON p.org_id = $3 AND p.id = c.parent_team_id WHERE c.hop < $8 ) SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.id) u.id, u.uuid, u.full_name, c.team_name, c.is_primary, c.hop, c.sort FROM chain c JOIN users u ON u.org_id = $4 AND u.id = c.lead_user_id AND u.status = $9 WHERE u.id <> $5 ORDER BY u.id, c.is_primary DESC, c.hop ASC

from_phone, CASE e.direction WHEN $58 THEN regexp_replace(coalesce(e.our_phone, $59), $60, $61, $62) ELSE regexp_replace(coalesce(e.customer_phone, $63), $64, $65, $66) END AS to_phone, e.started_at, $67::timestamptz AS answered_at, e.started_at + make_interval(secs => e.duration_sec) AS ended_at, CASE WHEN e.handler_user_id IS NULL THEN $68 ELSE $69 END AS handler_type, e.handler_user_id, WITH ev AS ( SELECT r.flow_id, r.contact_id, r.status, r.source, r.started_at, r.ended_at, r.failure_reason, r.last_activity_at FROM flow_runs r WHERE r.org_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT s.flow_id, s.contact_id, $5, s.source, coalesce(s.enrolled_at, s.created_at), s.failed_at, s.failure_reason, s.failed_at FROM flow_subscribers s WHERE s.org_id = $2 AND s.status = $6 AND s.last_run_id IS NULL) SELECT f.uuid, f.flow_name, f.is_active, f.is_published, count(*)::int AS runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ($7,$8,$9,$10))::int AS running, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $11)::int AS completed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $12)::int AS failed, avg(extract($13 FROM (r.ended_at - r.started_at))) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $14) AS avg_secs FROM ev r JOIN flows f ON f.org_id = $3 AND f.id = r.flow_id WHERE r.started_at >= $4::timestamptz AND $15 GROUP BY f.uuid, f.flow_name, f.is_active, f.is_published ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT $16

SELECT f.id, f.uuid, f.user_id, f.flow_name, f.category, f.flow_type, f.builder, f.trigger_kind, f.trigger_value, f.trigger_keywords, f.trigger_device_id, f.trigger_channel_id, f.provider, f.is_published, f.is_active, f.published_at, f.created_at, f.updated_at, to_char(f.updated_at at time zone $2, $3) AS updated_at_iso, f.row_version, coalesce(jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.flow_data->$4) = $5 THEN f.flow_data->$6 END), $7) AS node_count, coalesce(jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.flow_data->$8) = $9 THEN f.flow_data->$10 END), $11) AS edge_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_subscribers s WHERE s.org_id = f.org_id AND s.flow_id = f.id AND s.status = $12) AS sub_active, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_subscribers s WHERE s.org_id = f.org_id AND s.flow_id = f.id AND s.status = $13) AS sub_completed, (SELECT count(*) FROM flow_subscribers s WHERE s.org_id = f.org_id AND s.flow_id = f.id AND s.status = $14) AS sub_failed , f.flow_data FROM flows f WHERE f.org_id = $1 ORDER BY f.is_published DESC, f.is_active DESC, f.updated_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT $15

SELECT extract($6 FROM w.started_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::int AS weekday, extract($7 FROM w.started_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::int AS hour, count(*) AS calls FROM (SELECT $8::text AS source, w.org_id, w.id AS row_id, w.uuid, w.direction, w.status, w.duration_sec, w.end_reason, w.from_phone, w.to_phone, w.started_at, w.answered_at, w.ended_at, w.handler_type, w.handler_user_id, w.contact_id, w.wa_provider_config_id, (w.recording_path IS NOT NULL) AS has_recording, (CASE WHEN w.status = $9 THEN $10 WHEN w.status = $11 AND w.duration_sec > $12 THEN $13 WHEN w.status = $14 AND upper(coalesce(w.end_reason, $15)) IN ($16, $17) THEN $18 WHEN w.status = $19 THEN $20 ELSE $21 END) AS log_status, (w.status = $22 AND w.duration_sec > $23) AS is_answered, (w.direction = $24 AND w.status IN ($25, $26) AND w.duration_sec <= $27) AS is_missed, $28::text AS outcome, $29::text AS notes, $30::text AS number_label FROM wa_calls w UNION ALL SELECT e.source, e.org_id, e.id AS row_id, e.uuid, CASE e.direction WHEN $31 THEN $32 ELSE $33 END AS direction, CASE WHEN e.outcome IN ($34, $35) THEN $36 ELSE $37 END AS status, e.duration_sec, CASE e.outcome WHEN $38 THEN $39 WHEN $40 THEN $41 WHEN $42 THEN $43 WHEN $44 THEN $45 WHEN $46 THEN $47 ELSE $48 END AS end_reason, CASE e.direction WHEN $49 THEN regexp_replace(coalesce(e.customer_phone, $50), $51, $52, $53) ELSE regexp_replace(coalesce(e.our_phone, $54), $55, $56, $57) END AS from_phone, CASE e.direction WHEN $58 THEN regexp_replace(coalesce(e.our_phone, $59), $60, $61, $62) ELSE regexp_replace(coalesce(e.customer_phone, $63), $64, $65, $66) END AS to_phone, e.started_at, $67::timestamptz AS answered_at, e.started_at + make_interval(secs => e.duration_sec) AS ended_at, CASE WHEN e.handler_user_id IS NULL THEN $68 ELSE $69 END AS handler_type, e.handler_user_id, e.contact_id, $70::bigint AS wa_provider_config_id, (e.recording_ref IS NOT NULL) AS has_recording, CASE e.outcome WHEN $71 THEN $72 WHEN $73 THEN $74 WHEN $75 THEN $76 WHEN $77 THEN $78 ELSE $79 END AS log_status, (e.outcome = $80) AS is_answered, (e.direction = $81 AND e.outcome <> $82) AS is_missed, e.outcome, e.notes, e.number_label FROM call_log_entries e) w LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.org_id = w.org_id AND ct.id = w.contact_id LEFT JOIN wa_provider_configs cfg ON cfg.org_id = w.org_id AND cfg.id = w.wa_provider_config_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = w.org_id AND u.id = w.handler_user_id WHERE w.org_id = $3 AND w.started_at >= $4::timestamptz AND w.started_at < $5::timestamptz GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

$34, $35) AS sla_first_response_due, to_char(c.sla_resolution_due AT TIME ZONE $36, $37) AS sla_resolution_due, c.sla_breached, COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object($38, lt.uuid, $39, lt.name::text, $40, lt.color) ORDER BY lt.name) FROM conversation_tag lx JOIN tags lt ON lt.org_id = lx.org_id AND lt.id = lx.tag_id WHERE lx.org_id = c.org_id AND lx.conversation_id = c.id), $41::json) AS labels, ( SELECT CASE WHEN mb.id IS NULL THEN $1::bigint WHEN mb.scope = $42 THEN mb.owner_user_id END FROM channels och LEFT JOIN mail_mailboxes mb ON mb.org_id = och.org_id AND vch.id = c.channel_id AND vch.kind = $45 LEFT JOIN mail_mailboxes vmb ON vmb.org_id = vch.org_id AND vmb.uuid::text = vch.external_id WHERE c.org_id = $2 AND c.last_message_at IS NOT NULL AND WITH per_conversation AS ( SELECT m.conversation_id, min(m.created_at) FILTER (WHERE m.direction = $10) AS at, min(m.created_at) FILTER (WHERE m.direction = $11) AS first_out FROM messages m WHERE m.org_id = $1 AND (m.kind NOT IN ($12, $13) AND m.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (NOT (COALESCE(m.meta ->> $14, $15) = $16 AND m.meta ->> $17 IS NOT NULL)) AND (NOT (COALESCE(m.meta ->> $18, $19) = $20 AND (m.meta ->> $21 IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(m.provider_message_id, $22) LIKE $23))) AND m.created_at >= $2 AND m.created_at < $3 GROUP BY m.conversation_id HAVING bool_or(m.direction = $24)), first_in AS ( SELECT p.conversation_id, p.at, p.first_out FROM per_conversation p JOIN conversations c ON c.org_id = $4 AND c.id = p.conversation_id LEFT JOIN channels vch ON vch.org_id = c.org_id AND vch.id = c.channel_id AND vch.kind = $25 LEFT JOIN mail_mailboxes vmb ON vmb.org_id = vch.org_id AND vmb.uuid::text = vch.external_id WHERE ((COALESCE((CASE WHEN vch.id IS NULL THEN $26 WHEN vmb.id IS NULL THEN $5::bigint WHEN vmb.scope = $27 THEN vmb.owner_user_id END) = $6, $28) OR ((CASE WHEN vch.id IS NULL THEN $29 WHEN vmb.id IS NULL THEN $7::bigint WHEN vmb.scope = $30 THEN vmb.owner_user_id END) IS NULL AND $31))) ) SELECT avg(EXTRACT($32 FROM (o.at - f.at)))::int AS seconds FROM first_in f CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN f.first_out > f.at THEN f.first_out ELSE (SELECT min(m2.created_at) FROM messages m2 WHERE m2.org_id = $8 AND m2.conversation_id = f.conversation_id AND m2.direction = $33 AND (m2.kind NOT IN ($34, $35) AND m2.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (NOT (COALESCE(m2.meta ->> $36, $37) = $38 AND m2.meta ->> $39 IS NOT NULL)) AND (NOT (COALESCE(m2.meta ->> $40, $41) = $42 AND (m2.meta ->> $43 IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(m2.provider_message_id, $44) LIKE $45))) AND m2.created_at > f.at AND m2.created_at < $9) END AS at) o WHERE o.at IS NOT NULL
SELECT * FROM google_consent_requests WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid

SELECT bt.id AS type_id, bt.uuid AS type_uuid, bt.name AS type_name, r.step_kind, r.kind, r.offset_minutes, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $4) AS sent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $5 AND r.delivery = $6) AS delivered, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $7) AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $8) AS skipped, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $9 AND jsonb_array_length(r.attempt_log) > $10 AND jsonb_path_exists(r.attempt_log, $11)) AS fallback_used, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.reply_state -> $12 ->> $13 IS NOT NULL) AS btn_confirm, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.reply_state -> $14 ->> $15 IS NOT NULL) AS btn_reschedule, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.reply_state -> $16 ->> $17 IS NOT NULL) AS btn_cancel FROM appointment_reminder_runs r JOIN appointments a ON a.org_id = r.org_id AND a.id = r.appointment_id JOIN booking_types bt ON bt.org_id = a.org_id AND bt.id = a.booking_type_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND r.due_at >= $2 AND r.due_at < $3 GROUP BY bt.id, bt.uuid, bt.name, r.step_kind, r.kind, r.offset_minutes

WITH due AS ( SELECT a.org_id, a.id AS appointment_id, r.id AS reminder_id, r.kind, r.offset_minutes, a.armed_at, r.step_kind, CASE r.kind WHEN $3 THEN a.starts_at - make_interval(mins => r.offset_minutes) ELSE a.ends_at + make_interval(mins => r.offset_minutes) END AS due_at FROM appointments a JOIN booking_reminders r ON r.org_id = a.org_id AND r.booking_type_id = a.booking_type_id AND r.is_active WHERE ( (r.kind = $4 AND a.status = $5 AND a.starts_at > now() AND a.starts_at <= now() + interval $6) OR (r.kind = $7 AND r.step_kind IS DISTINCT FROM $8 AND a.status IN ($9, $10) AND a.ends_at <= now() AND a.ends_at > now() - interval $11) OR (r.kind = $12 AND r.step_kind = $13 AND a.status = $14 AND a.ends_at <= now() AND a.ends_at > now() - interval $15) ) ), ready AS ( SELECT * FROM due d WHERE d.due_at <= now() AND d.due_at > d.armed_at AND (d.kind = $16 OR d.due_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT $17 FROM appointment_reminder_runs x WHERE x.org_id = d.org_id AND x.appointment_id = d.appointment_id AND x.kind = d.kind AND x.offset_minutes = d.offset_minutes AND x.armed_at = d.armed_at) ORDER BY d.due_at, d.appointment_id LIMIT $2 ), claimed AS ( INSERT INTO appointment_reminder_runs (org_id, appointment_id, reminder_id, kind, step_kind, offset_minutes, due_at, armed_at, status, next_attempt_at) SELECT org_id, appointment_id, reminder_id, kind, step_kind, offset_minutes, due_at, armed_at, $18, now() FROM ready ON CONFLICT (org_id, appointment_id, kind, offset_minutes, armed_at) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, org_id, appointment_id, kind, step_kind, offset_minutes, due_at ) SELECT c.id AS run_id, c.org_id, c.appointment_id, c.kind, c.step_kind, c.offset_minutes, c.due_at, a.uuid, a.starts_at, a.ends_at, a.timezone, bt.uuid AS type_uuid FROM claimed c JOIN appointments a ON a.org_id = c.org_id AND a.id = c.appointment_id LEFT JOIN booking_types bt ON bt.org_id = a.org_id AND bt.id = a.booking_type_id

SELECT p.*, t.template_name, s.uuid AS series_uuid, CASE WHEN coalesce(p.provider, $3) = $4 THEN (SELECT coalesce(nullif(d.device_name, $5), nullif(trim(coalesce(d.country_code, $6) || $7 || coalesce(d.phone_number, $8)), $9)) FROM devices d WHERE d.org_id = p.org_id AND d.id = p.device_id) ELSE (SELECT coalesce(nullif(w.display_label, $10), w.phone_number) FROM wa_provider_configs w WHERE w.org_id = p.org_id AND w.id = p.device_id) END AS sender_label, to_char(p.sort_at AT TIME ZONE $11, $12) AS sort_iso, agg.* FROM ( SELECT c.org_id, c.id, c.uuid, c.campaign_name, c.status, c.wizard IS NOT NULL AS is_wizard, c.series_id, c.occurrence_no, (CASE WHEN c.series_id IS NOT NULL THEN $13 ELSE c.schedule_type END) AS kind, c.run_at, c.last_run_at, c.completed_at, c.created_at, c.template_id, c.provider, c.device_id, coalesce(c.last_run_at, c.created_at) AS sort_at FROM wpcampaigns c WHERE c.org_id = $1 AND c.status NOT IN ($14, $15) ORDER BY coalesce(c.last_run_at, c.created_at) DESC, c.uuid DESC LIMIT $2 ) p LEFT JOIN wa_templates t ON t.org_id = p.org_id AND t.id = p.template_id LEFT JOIN camp_series s ON s.org_id = p.org_id AND s.id = p.series_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::int AS a_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ($16,$17,$18,$19) OR r.sent_at IS NOT NULL OR r.delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR r.read_at IS NOT NULL OR r.responded_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_sent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ($20,$21,$22) OR r.delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR r.read_at IS NOT NULL OR r.responded_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_delivered, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ($23,$24) OR r.read_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_read, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $25 OR r.responded_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_replies, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.clicked OR r.clicked_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_clicks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $26)::int AS a_failed FROM wp_campaign_contacts r WHERE r.org_id = p.org_id AND r.campaign_id = p.id ) agg ON $27 ORDER BY p.sort_at DESC, p.uuid DESC

w.handler_type, w.has_recording, to_char(w.started_at AT TIME ZONE $3, $4) AS started_iso, ct.uuid AS contact_uuid, coalesce(ct.name, ct.first_name) AS contact_name, cfg.uuid AS number_uuid, coalesce(w.number_label, cfg.display_label, cfg.phone_number) AS number_label, u.uuid AS handler_uuid, u.full_name AS handler_name, tk.uuid AS task_uuid FROM (SELECT $5::text AS source, w.org_id, w.id w.wa_provider_config_id, (w.recording_path IS NOT NULL) AS has_recording, (CASE WHEN w.status = $6 THEN $7 WHEN w.status = $8 AND w.duration_sec > $9 THEN $10 WHEN w.status = $11 AND upper(coalesce(w.end_reason, $12)) IN ($13, $14) THEN $15 WHEN w.status = $16 THEN $17 ELSE $18 END) AS log_status, (w.status = $19 AND w.duration_sec > $20) AS is_answered, (w.direction = $21 AND w.status IN ($22, $23) AND w.duration_sec <= $24) AS is_missed, $25::text AS outcome, $26::text AS notes, $27::text AS number_label FROM wa_calls w UNION ALL SELECT e.source, e.org_id, e.id AS row_id, e.uuid, CASE e.direction WHEN $28 THEN $29 ELSE $30 END AS direction, CASE WHEN e.outcome IN ($31, $32) THEN $33 ELSE $34 END AS status, e.duration_sec, CASE e.outcome WHEN $35 THEN $36 WHEN $37 THEN $38 WHEN $39 THEN $40 WHEN $41 THEN $42 WHEN $43 THEN $44 ELSE $45 END AS end_reason, CASE e.direction WHEN $46 THEN regexp_replace(coalesce(e.customer_phone, $47), $48, $49, $50) ELSE regexp_replace(coalesce(e.our_phone, $51), $52, $53, $54) END AS from_phone, CASE e.direction WHEN $55 THEN regexp_replace(coalesce(e.our_phone, $56), $57, $58, $59) ELSE regexp_replace(coalesce(e.customer_phone, $60), $61, $62, $63) END AS to_phone, e.started_at, $64::timestamptz AS answered_at, e.started_at + make_interval(secs => e.duration_sec) AS ended_at, CASE WHEN e.handler_user_id IS NULL THEN $65 ELSE $66 END AS handler_type, e.handler_user_id, e.contact_id, $67::bigint AS wa_provider_config_id, (e.recording_ref IS NOT NULL) AS has_recording, CASE e.outcome WHEN $68 THEN $69 WHEN $70 THEN $71 WHEN $72 THEN $73 WHEN $74 THEN $75 ELSE $76 END AS log_status, (e.outcome = $77) AS is_answered, (e.direction = $78 AND e.outcome <> $79) AS is_missed, SELECT to_char(d.day, $13) AS date, sum(d.sent)::int AS sent, sum(d.delivered)::int AS delivered, sum(d.read)::int AS read, sum(d.replies)::int AS replies FROM ( SELECT (sent_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS day, $14 AS sent, $15 AS delivered, $16 AS read, $17 AS replies FROM wp_campaign_contacts WHERE org_id = $2 AND campaign_id = $3 AND sent_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT (delivered_at AT TIME ZONE $4)::date, $18, $19, $20, $21 FROM wp_campaign_contacts WHERE org_id = $5 AND campaign_id = $6 AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT (read_at AT TIME ZONE $7)::date, $22, $23, $24, $25 FROM wp_campaign_contacts WHERE org_id = $8 AND campaign_id = $9 AND read_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT (responded_at AT TIME ZONE $10)::date, $26, $27, $28, $29 FROM wp_campaign_contacts WHERE org_id = $11 AND campaign_id = $12 AND responded_at IS NOT NULL ) d GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day

SELECT id, uuid, status, is_primary, phone_number, display_label, credentials_json, meta_json, connected_at, last_health_at, row_version FROM wa_provider_configs WHERE org_id = $1 AND provider = $2 ORDER BY is_primary DESC, connected_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC

SELECT id, uuid, title, purpose, slug, audience_type, submission_cap, cap_reached_note, send_button_label, thank_you_note, definition_json, status, meta_flow_id, provider_config_id, published_at, publish_error, submission_count, created_at, row_version, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE $3, $4) AS created_at_iso FROM wa_forms WHERE org_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT id, uuid, bot_id, bot_username, bot_name, bot_token, webhook_token, webhook_token_enc, secret_token, active, connected_at, last_inbound_at, last_error, payment_provider_token, payment_provider, row_version FROM telegram_bots WHERE org_id = $1 ORDER BY id
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM flows WHERE org_id = $1 AND flow_type = $2

SELECT s.id, s.uuid, s.assistant_id, a.uuid AS assistant_uuid, s.kind, s.label, s.url, (s.file_path IS NOT NULL) AS has_file, s.status, s.tokens_estimate, s.error, s.created_at, s.file_path, s.content, s.question, s.answer FROM ai_training_sources s LEFT JOIN ai_chat_assistants a ON a.org_id = s.org_id AND a.id = s.assistant_id WHERE s.org_id = $1 AND s.uuid = $2

SELECT c.uuid, coalesce(c.title, c.peer_name, $3 || c.peer_key) AS title, c.last_message_at, coalesce(c.preview, $4) AS preview, c.unread_count FROM conversations c WHERE c.org_id = $1 AND NOT c.archived AND ( SELECT CASE WHEN mb.id IS NULL THEN $2::bigint WHEN mb.scope = $5 THEN mb.owner_user_id END FROM channels och LEFT JOIN mail_mailboxes mb ON mb.org_id = och.org_id AND mb.uuid::text = och.external_id WHERE och.org_id = c.org_id AND och.id = c.channel_id AND och.kind = $6 ) IS NULL ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT $7
SELECT uuid, id, name, page_id FROM facebook_pages WHERE org_id = $1 AND (status = $2) ORDER BY name, id
SELECT country_code, category, margin_bps FROM workspace_message_margins WHERE org_id = $1
SELECT slot, etag FROM workspace_brand_assets WHERE org_id = $1
SELECT id, uuid, instaflow_account_id, username, name, avatar, status, followers, synced_at, created_at, row_version FROM workspace_ig_accounts WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, uuid, provider, api_key, key_last4, is_active, row_version, updated_at FROM ai_provider_keys WHERE org_id = $1 ORDER BY provider

SELECT count(*)::int AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.phone_number IS NULL AND r.contact_id IS NULL)::int AS invalid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.is_unsubscribed OR r.status = $3 OR (c.is_unsubscribed AND r.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(c.unsubscribed_at, r.sent_at) >= r.sent_at)))::int AS opted_out FROM wp_campaign_contacts r LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = r.org_id AND c.id = r.contact_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND r.campaign_id = $2

SELECT id, uuid, line_channel_id, basic_id, display_name, picture_url, channel_access_token, channel_secret, assertion_kid, assertion_private_key, rotating_token, rotating_token_key_id, rotating_token_expires_at, webhook_token, webhook_token_enc, active, connected_at, last_inbound_at, last_error, row_version FROM line_channels WHERE org_id = $1 ORDER BY id
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM facebook_posts p WHERE p.org_id = $1

SELECT id, uuid, name, slug, country_code, phone_number, welcome_message, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, click_count, last_clicked_at, expires_at, status, created_at, row_version, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE $3, $4) AS created_at_iso FROM wa_chat_links WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid
SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM outbound_webhooks WHERE org_id = $1) + (SELECT count(*) FROM webhooks WHERE org_id = $2))::int AS n

SELECT id, uuid, ticket_number, subject, message, reason, status, created_at, resolved_at FROM support_tickets WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2
SELECT uuid, store_name, store_url, store_currency AS currency FROM woocommerce_integrations WHERE org_id = $1 AND status = $2 ORDER BY connected_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC
SELECT tm.user_id, t.uuid AS team_uuid FROM team_members tm JOIN teams t ON t.org_id = tm.org_id AND t.id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.org_id = $1 AND tm.user_id IN ($2) ORDER BY t.sort, t.name

SELECT f.uuid AS flow_uuid, f.flow_name, f.is_published, f.is_active, f.updated_at, w.uuid AS widget_uuid, w.header_title, w.status AS widget_status, w.customized_at FROM flows f LEFT JOIN chatbot_widgets w ON w.org_id = f.org_id AND w.flow_id = f.id WHERE f.org_id = $1 AND f.flow_type = $3 ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT count(*)::int AS unread, min(c.last_message_at) AS oldest FROM conversations c WHERE c.org_id = $1 AND NOT c.archived AND c.unread_count > $3 AND ( SELECT CASE WHEN mb.id IS NULL THEN $2::bigint WHEN mb.scope = $4 THEN mb.owner_user_id END FROM channels och LEFT JOIN mail_mailboxes mb ON mb.org_id = och.org_id AND mb.uuid::text = och.external_id WHERE och.org_id = c.org_id AND och.id = c.channel_id AND och.kind = $5 ) IS NULL
SELECT d.lost_reason AS reason, count(*)::int AS n FROM deals d WHERE d.org_id = $1 AND d.status = $2 GROUP BY d.lost_reason ORDER BY n DESC, reason NULLS LAST LIMIT $3

SELECT p.id, p.uuid, p.name, p.first_response_minutes, p.resolution_minutes, p.respect_business_hours, p.priority_overrides, p.is_default, p.row_version, to_char(p.created_at AT TIME ZONE $2, $3) AS created_at, to_char(p.updated_at AT TIME ZONE $4, $5) AS updated_at, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM conversations c WHERE c.org_id = p.org_id AND c.sla_policy_id = p.id) AS conversation_count FROM sla_policies p WHERE p.org_id = $1 ORDER BY p.is_default DESC, p.id

SELECT i.currency, sum(greatest(i.total_minor - i.paid_minor - i.credited_minor, $3))::text AS outstanding, coalesce(sum(greatest(i.total_minor - i.paid_minor - i.credited_minor, $4)) FILTER (WHERE i.due_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE $1)::date), $5)::text AS overdue FROM invoices i WHERE i.org_id = $2 AND i.status = $6 AND i.payment_status <> $7 GROUP BY i.currency ORDER BY i.currency
SELECT timezone, timezone_source FROM contacts WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2

SELECT m.id, m.created_at::text AS created_at_text, m.created_at, m.uuid, m.conversation_id, c.uuid AS conversation_uuid, m.seq, m.direction, m.kind, m.sender_kind, m.sender_user_id, u.uuid AS sender_user_uuid, u.full_name AS sender_name, m.body, m.media_key, m.media_mime, m.media_size, m.media_name, m.media_sha256, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.status, m.failure_code, m.failure_reason, m.client_message_id, m.provider_message_id, m.reply_to_message_uuid, m.reaction, m.is_translated, m.translated_body, m.detected_language, m.translation_status, m.starred, m.pinned, m.edited_at, m.deleted_at, m.template_id, wt.uuid AS template_uuid, m.meta, m.provider_ts, m.sent_at, m.delivered_at, m.read_at FROM messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.org_id = m.org_id AND c.id = m.conversation_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = m.org_id AND u.id = m.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN wa_templates wt ON wt.org_id = m.org_id AND wt.id = m.template_id WHERE m.org_id = $1 AND m.uuid = $2 LIMIT $3
SELECT key FROM fields WHERE org_id = $1 AND module_key = $2 AND field_type = $3 AND is_active ORDER BY position, id LIMIT $4

SELECT o.id, o.uuid, o.created_at, to_char(o.created_at at time zone $3, $4) AS created_at_iso, o.number, o.status, o.quote_id, q.uuid AS quote_uuid, q.number AS quote_number, q.doc_type AS quote_kind, o.contact_id, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, c.name AS contact_name, o.company_id, o.deal_id, dl.uuid AS deal_uuid, dl.title AS deal_title, o.owner_id, ou.uuid AS owner_uuid, ou.full_name AS owner_name, o.created_by, o.buyer_name, o.buyer_email, o.buyer_phone, o.currency, o.currency_exponent, o.subtotal_minor::text, o.shipping_minor::text, o.tax_minor::text, o.tax_added_minor::text, o.total_minor::text, o.shipping_invoiced, o.reference, to_char(o.expected_date, $5) AS expected_date, o.notes, o.terms, o.confirmed_at, o.cancelled_at, o.cancel_reason, o.row_version, (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices i WHERE i.org_id = o.org_id AND i.sales_order_id = o.id AND i.status <> $6)::int AS invoice_count, x.qt::text AS qty_total, x.qi::text AS qty_invoiced, x.qf::text AS qty_fulfilled FROM sales_orders o LEFT JOIN sales_docs q ON q.org_id = o.org_id AND q.id = o.quote_id LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = o.org_id AND c.id = o.contact_id LEFT JOIN deals dl ON dl.org_id = o.org_id AND dl.id = o.deal_id LEFT JOIN users ou ON ou.org_id = o.org_id AND ou.id = o.owner_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT coalesce(sum(i.qty), $7) AS qt, coalesce(sum(i.qty_invoiced), $8) AS qi, coalesce(sum(i.qty_fulfilled), $9) AS qf FROM sales_order_items i WHERE i.org_id = o.org_id AND i.order_id = o.id) x ON $10 WHERE o.org_id = $1 ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT d.id, d.uuid, to_char(d.created_at at time zone $3, $4) AS created_at_iso, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.title, d.value_minor::text AS value_minor, d.currency, d.status, d.source, d.lost_reason, d.lost_reason_id, lr.uuid AS lost_reason_uuid, d.notes, to_char(d.expected_close_date, $5) AS expected_close_date, d.sort_order::text AS sort_order, d.won_at, d.lost_at, d.row_version, d.pipeline_id, p.uuid AS pipeline_uuid, p.name AS pipeline_name, d.stage_id, s.uuid AS stage_uuid, s.name AS stage_name, s.color AS stage_color, s.probability AS stage_probability, s.is_won AS stage_is_won, s.is_lost AS stage_is_lost, d.owner_user_id AS owner_id, d.created_by, u.uuid AS owner_uuid, u.full_name AS owner_name, d.contact_id, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, c.name AS contact_name, c.phone AS contact_phone, c.email::text AS contact_email, d.company_id, co.uuid AS company_uuid, co.name AS company_name FROM deals d JOIN pipelines p ON p.org_id = d.org_id AND p.id = d.pipeline_id JOIN pipeline_stages s ON s.org_id = d.org_id AND s.id = d.stage_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = d.org_id AND u.id = d.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = d.org_id AND c.id = d.contact_id LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.org_id = d.org_id AND co.id = d.company_id LEFT JOIN deal_lost_reasons lr ON lr.org_id = d.org_id AND lr.id = d.lost_reason_id WHERE d.org_id = $1 ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT t.uuid, t.name, t.color, t.assignment_strategy, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM team_members m WHERE m.org_id = t.org_id AND m.team_id = t.id) AS members FROM teams t WHERE t.org_id = $1 AND t.receives_conversations ORDER BY t.sort, lower(t.name), t.id
SELECT uuid, keyword, status FROM keyword_replies WHERE org_id = $1 AND provider = $2 AND ig_trigger = $3 ORDER BY keyword, id

SELECT p.currency, coalesce(sum(p.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = $3), $4)::text AS collected, coalesce(sum(-p.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = $5), $6)::text AS refunded FROM payments p LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.org_id = p.org_id AND i.id = p.invoice_id WHERE p.org_id = $1 AND p.paid_at >= now() - ($2::int * interval $7) AND p.paid_at <= now() GROUP BY p.currency ORDER BY p.currency
SELECT uuid, id, display_name, basic_id FROM line_channels WHERE org_id = $1 AND (active) ORDER BY display_name, id

SELECT coalesce(r.recipient_name, c.name, $4) AS name, coalesce(r.phone_number, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT $5 FROM wpcampaigns w WHERE w.org_id = r.org_id AND w.id = r.campaign_id AND w.provider = $6 ) THEN c.email::text ELSE c.phone END, $7) AS phone, coalesce(r.unsubscribed_at, c.unsubscribed_at) AS unsubscribed_at, r.sent_at FROM wp_campaign_contacts r LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = r.org_id AND c.id = r.contact_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND r.campaign_id = $2 AND (r.is_unsubscribed OR r.status = $8 OR (c.is_unsubscribed AND r.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(c.unsubscribed_at, r.sent_at) >= r.sent_at)) ORDER BY coalesce(r.unsubscribed_at, c.unsubscribed_at, r.sent_at) DESC NULLS LAST, r.id DESC LIMIT $3
SELECT id, owner_id, created_by, name, email, phone FROM contacts WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid
SELECT id, uuid FROM wpcampaigns WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid IN ($2::uuid)

SELECT b.id, b.uuid, b.name, b.viber_channel_id, ch.uuid AS channel_uuid, ch.bot_name AS channel_name, t.uuid AS template_uuid, b.body, b.buttons, b.media_path, b.media_kind, b.media_size, b.status, b.total, b.sent, b.failed, b.delivered, b.seen, b.last_error, b.started_at, b.finished_at, b.created_at, b.row_version FROM viber_broadcasts b JOIN viber_channels ch ON ch.org_id = b.org_id AND ch.id = b.viber_channel_id LEFT JOIN wa_templates t ON t.org_id = b.org_id AND t.id = b.template_id WHERE b.org_id = $1 ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT o.id, o.org_id, o.uuid, o.order_number, o.user_id, o.kind, o.plan_slug, o.billing_period, o.currency, o.amount::text AS amount, o.discount_amount::text AS discount_amount, o.tax_rate::text AS tax_rate, o.tax_amount::text AS tax_amount, o.total_amount::text AS total_amount, o.coupon_code, o.coupon_id, o.gateway_id, o.gateway_slug, o.status, o.gateway_order_id, o.gateway_payment_id, o.failure_reason, o.wallet_topup_minor, o.wallet_unit, o.return_token, o.customer_name, o.customer_email, o.description, o.created_at, o.paid_at, o.row_version, o.auto_renew, to_char(o.created_at AT TIME ZONE $4, $5) AS created_at_iso, p.name AS plan_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN plans p ON p.slug = o.plan_slug WHERE o.org_id = $1 AND o.user_id = $2 ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT $3

SELECT error_message AS error, count(*)::int AS count FROM wp_campaign_contacts WHERE org_id = $1 AND campaign_id = $2 AND status = $4 AND error_message IS NOT NULL GROUP BY error_message ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT $3

SELECT to_char(date_trunc($1::text, created_at AT TIME ZONE $5), $6) AS start, count(*)::int AS signups, coalesce(sum(credits_awarded), $7)::bigint AS credits FROM referrals WHERE referrer_org_id = $2 AND referrer_user_id = $3 AND created_at >= ($4::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE $8 GROUP BY 1
