SELECT id, provider, status, phone_number, display_label FROM wa_provider_configs WHERE org_id = $1 AND provider <> $2 ORDER BY is_primary DESC, connected_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $3
SELECT id FROM flow_subscribers WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ($3,$4,$5,$6) OR r.sent_at IS NOT NULL OR r.delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR r.read_at IS NOT NULL OR r.responded_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_sent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ($7,$8,$9) OR r.delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR r.read_at IS NOT NULL OR r.responded_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_delivered, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ($10,$11) OR r.read_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_read, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $12 OR r.responded_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_responded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.clicked OR r.clicked_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_clicked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = $13)::int AS a_failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ($14,$15,$16,$17,$18,$19,$20) OR r.sent_at IS NOT NULL OR r.delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR r.read_at IS NOT NULL OR r.responded_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS a_terminal, count(*)::int AS a_total FROM wp_campaign_contacts r WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND r.campaign_id = $2
SELECT uuid, coalesce(display_label, phone_number) AS label, phone_number FROM wa_provider_configs WHERE org_id = $1 AND provider = $2 ORDER BY is_primary DESC, connected_at DESC NULLS LAST, id
SELECT uuid, name FROM contact_groups WHERE org_id = $1 ORDER BY lower(name), id

SELECT id, uuid, line_channel_id, basic_id, display_name, picture_url, channel_access_token, channel_secret, assertion_kid, assertion_private_key, rotating_token, rotating_token_key_id, rotating_token_expires_at, webhook_token, webhook_token_enc, active, connected_at, last_inbound_at, last_error, row_version FROM line_channels WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid

SELECT g.name AS name, count(DISTINCT r.id)::int AS recipients, count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.responded_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS replies, count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.read_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS reads, count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE (r.is_unsubscribed OR r.status = $3 OR (c.is_unsubscribed AND r.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(c.unsubscribed_at, r.sent_at) >= r.sent_at)))::int AS opt_outs FROM wp_campaign_contacts r LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = r.org_id AND c.id = r.contact_id JOIN contact_group_members gm ON gm.org_id = r.org_id AND gm.contact_id = r.contact_id JOIN contact_groups g ON g.org_id = gm.org_id AND g.id = gm.group_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND r.campaign_id = $2 GROUP BY g.id, g.name
SELECT * FROM appointment_feed_tokens WHERE org_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
SELECT personal_mailboxes_enabled, who_may_connect_personal, admins_can_read_personal, row_version FROM mail_workspace_settings WHERE org_id = $1
SELECT id, is_active FROM flows WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid

SELECT count(*)::int AS all, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = $2 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())))::int AS live, coalesce(sum(click_count), $3)::int AS total_clicks FROM wa_chat_links WHERE org_id = $1

SELECT bt.id AS type_id, r.step_kind, r.kind, r.offset_minutes, r.reason, count(*) AS n FROM appointment_reminder_runs r JOIN appointments a ON a.org_id = r.org_id AND a.id = r.appointment_id JOIN booking_types bt ON bt.org_id = a.org_id AND bt.id = a.booking_type_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND r.due_at >= $2 AND r.due_at < $3 AND r.status = $4 GROUP BY bt.id, r.step_kind, r.kind, r.offset_minutes, r.reason
SELECT key, label FROM fields WHERE org_id = $1 AND module_key = $2 AND is_active AND NOT is_hidden AND NOT is_system AND field_type <> $3 ORDER BY position, id
SELECT uuid, id, account_name, wx_id FROM wechat_channels WHERE org_id = $1 AND (active) ORDER BY account_name, id
SELECT id, uuid, provider, label, numbers, status, plays_recording_notice FROM telephony_connections WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid FOR UPDATE

SELECT f.id, f.org_id, CASE WHEN f.is_published AND f.published_flow_data IS NOT NULL THEN f.published_trigger_kind ELSE f.trigger_kind END AS trigger_kind, CASE WHEN f.is_published AND f.published_flow_data IS NOT NULL THEN f.published_trigger_config ELSE f.trigger_config END AS trigger_config, f.trigger_last_occurrence, coalesce(ws.timezone, $1) AS tz FROM flows f LEFT JOIN workspace_settings ws ON ws.org_id = f.org_id WHERE f.is_published AND f.is_active AND CASE WHEN f.is_published AND f.published_flow_data IS NOT NULL THEN f.published_trigger_kind ELSE f.trigger_kind END IN ($2, $3) ORDER BY f.id
SELECT uuid, title, status, meta_flow_id FROM wa_forms WHERE org_id = $1 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM team_chat_invitations WHERE org_id = $1 AND status = $2

SELECT coalesce((SELECT sla_days FROM privacy_settings WHERE org_id = $1), $3) AS sla_days, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ($4, $5, $6))::int AS open, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ($7, $8, $9) AND due_at < now())::int AS overdue FROM privacy_requests WHERE org_id = $2

SELECT id, uuid, bot_id, bot_username, bot_name, bot_token, webhook_token, webhook_token_enc, secret_token, active, connected_at, last_inbound_at, last_error, payment_provider_token, payment_provider, row_version FROM telegram_bots WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid

SELECT a.status, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ($3, $4) AND a.starts_at >= now()) AS upcoming, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.starts_at < now()) AS past, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.needs_review) AS review, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ($5, $6) AND a.starts_at >= now() AND a.user_id = $1) AS mine FROM appointments a WHERE a.org_id = $2 GROUP BY a.status

SELECT r.id, r.uuid, r.name, r.description, r.subject, r.conditions, r.rules, r.strategy, r.user_ids, r.team_ids, r.skip_offline, r.reassign_on_update, r.rr_cursor, r.sort, r.is_active, r.fired_count, r.last_fired_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.row_version, ub.uuid AS updated_by_uuid, ub.full_name AS updated_by_name FROM assignment_rules r LEFT JOIN users ub ON ub.org_id = r.org_id AND ub.id = r.updated_by WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND r.uuid = $2 FOR UPDATE OF r

SELECT id, uuid, status, phone_number, display_label, meta_json, credentials_json FROM wa_provider_configs w WHERE w.org_id = $1 AND w.provider = $2 ORDER BY w.is_primary DESC, w.connected_at DESC NULLS LAST, w.id DESC
SELECT id, uuid, name, slug, description, product_ids, is_active, meta_set_id, row_version, created_at, updated_at FROM wa_product_sets WHERE org_id = $1 ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT s.org_id, s.id, s.app_id, a.uuid AS app_uuid, a.slug, a.pricing_model, a.price_amount::text AS price_amount, a.price_currency, a.annual_amount::text AS annual_amount, a.trial_days, a.purchasable, a.included_plan_feature, a.included_min_plan, a.price_changed_at, a.grants_plan_features, a.grandfather_existing, a.billing_mode, a.price_lock FROM marketplace_subscriptions s JOIN marketplace_apps a ON a.id = s.app_id WHERE s.status = $2 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT $3 FROM workspace_addons a WHERE a.org_id = s.org_id AND a.package_id = s.pack_id AND a.status = $4 AND ( a.ends_at IS NULL OR a.ends_at > now() OR EXISTS ( SELECT $5 FROM subscriptions sb WHERE sb.org_id = a.org_id AND sb.workspace_addon_id = a.id AND sb.kind = $6 AND sb.status IN ($7, $8) AND a.ends_at > now() - make_interval(days => $9)))) ORDER BY s.current_period_end NULLS LAST, s.id LIMIT $1

SELECT w.id, w.recording_path, w.conversation_id, conv.uuid AS conversation_uuid, w.uuid, w.direction, w.status AS call_status, (CASE WHEN w.status = $3 THEN $4 WHEN w.status = $5 AND w.duration_sec > $6 THEN $7 WHEN w.status = $8 AND upper(coalesce(w.end_reason, $9)) IN ($10, $11) THEN $12 WHEN w.status = $13 THEN $14 ELSE $15 END) AS log_status, w.duration_sec, w.end_reason, w.from_phone, w.to_phone, w.started_at, w.answered_at, w.ended_at, w.handler_type, (w.recording_path IS NOT NULL) AS has_recording, ct.uuid AS contact_uuid, coalesce(ct.name, ct.first_name) AS contact_name, cfg.uuid AS number_uuid, coalesce(cfg.display_label, cfg.phone_number) AS number_label, u.uuid AS handler_uuid, u.full_name AS handler_name, w.recording_consent_status, w.recording_consent_method, w.recording_consent_at, w.recording_notice_version, w.recording_notice_sha256, w.recording_stored_at, w.recording_legal_hold, w.recording_hold_reason, w.recording_deleted_at, w.recording_deleted_reason, coalesce((SELECT s.retention_days FROM call_recording_settings s WHERE s.org_id = w.org_id), retention_live_days($16, $17)) AS retention_days FROM wa_calls w LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.org_id = w.org_id AND ct.id = w.contact_id LEFT JOIN wa_provider_configs cfg ON cfg.org_id = w.org_id AND cfg.id = w.wa_provider_config_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = w.org_id AND u.id = w.handler_user_id LEFT JOIN conversations conv ON conv.org_id = w.org_id AND conv.id = w.conversation_id WHERE w.org_id = $1 AND w.uuid = $2::uuid
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM wa_customer_profiles WHERE org_id = $1
SELECT data_residency FROM workspace_settings WHERE org_id = $1

SELECT r.id, r.uuid, r.request_type, r.status, r.subject_kind, r.contact_id, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, r.lead_id, l.uuid AS lead_uuid, r.subject_identifier_kind, r.subject_identifier_cipher, r.subject_label, r.requester_channel, r.internal_note, r.received_at, r.due_at, r.verification_method, r.verification_evidence_ref, r.verified_at, r.legal_hold, r.legal_hold_reason, r.restricted_at, r.restricted_hold_id, r.erasure_confirmed_by, r.erasure_confirmed_at, r.history_mode, r.rejection_reason, r.dry_run_at, r.dry_run_summary, r.result_summary, r.proof, r.proof_sha256, r.completed_at, r.created_at, r.row_version FROM privacy_requests r LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = r.org_id AND c.id = r.contact_id LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.org_id = r.org_id AND l.id = r.lead_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 ORDER BY r.received_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT count(*)::int AS "all", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (CASE WHEN i.status = $8 THEN $9 WHEN i.status = $10 THEN $11 WHEN i.payment_status = $12 THEN $13 WHEN i.due_date IS NOT NULL AND i.due_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE $1)::date THEN $14 WHEN i.payment_status = $15 THEN $16 ELSE $17 END) = $18)::int AS draft, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (CASE WHEN i.status = $19 THEN $20 WHEN i.status = $21 THEN $22 WHEN i.payment_status = $23 THEN $24 WHEN i.due_date IS NOT NULL AND i.due_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE $2)::date THEN $25 WHEN i.payment_status = $26 THEN $27 ELSE $28 END) = $29)::int AS issued, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (CASE WHEN i.status = $30 THEN $31 WHEN i.status = $32 THEN $33 WHEN i.payment_status = $34 THEN $35 WHEN i.due_date IS NOT NULL AND i.due_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE $3)::date THEN $36 WHEN i.payment_status = $37 THEN $38 ELSE $39 END) = $40)::int AS partially_paid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (CASE WHEN i.status = $41 THEN $42 WHEN i.status = $43 THEN $44 WHEN i.payment_status = $45 THEN $46 WHEN i.due_date IS NOT NULL AND i.due_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE $4)::date THEN $47 WHEN i.payment_status = $48 THEN $49 ELSE $50 END) = $51)::int AS paid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (CASE WHEN i.status = $52 THEN $53 WHEN i.status = $54 THEN $55 WHEN i.payment_status = $56 THEN $57 WHEN i.due_date IS NOT NULL AND i.due_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE $5)::date THEN $58 WHEN i.payment_status = $59 THEN $60 ELSE $61 END) = $62)::int AS overdue, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (CASE WHEN i.status = $63 THEN $64 WHEN i.status = $65 THEN $66 WHEN i.payment_status = $67 THEN $68 WHEN i.due_date IS NOT NULL AND i.due_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE $6)::date THEN $69 WHEN i.payment_status = $70 THEN $71 ELSE $72 END) = $73)::int AS void FROM invoices i WHERE i.org_id = $7

SELECT model, provider, sum(total_tokens)::bigint AS tokens, count(*)::bigint AS calls, sum(prompt_tokens)::bigint AS prompt_tokens, sum(completion_tokens)::bigint AS completion_tokens FROM ai_token_usage WHERE created_at >= $1 AND created_at < $2 AND org_id = $3 GROUP BY model, provider ORDER BY tokens DESC, provider, model LIMIT $4
SELECT uuid, id, bot_name, bot_uri FROM viber_channels WHERE org_id = $1 AND (active) ORDER BY bot_name, id

SELECT g.id, g.uuid, g.name, (SELECT count(*) FROM contact_group_members m JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = m.org_id AND c.id = m.contact_id AND NOT c.is_archived WHERE m.org_id = g.org_id AND m.group_id = g.id) AS member_count FROM contact_groups g WHERE g.org_id = $1 ORDER BY lower(g.name), g.id

SELECT b.id, b.uuid, b.name, b.wechat_channel_id, c.uuid AS channel_uuid, c.account_name AS channel_name, t.uuid AS template_uuid, b.body, b.audience, b.tag_id, b.mass_msg_id, b.status, b.total, b.sent, b.failed, b.last_error, b.started_at, b.finished_at, b.held_until, b.created_at, b.updated_at, b.row_version FROM wechat_broadcasts b JOIN wechat_channels c ON c.org_id = b.org_id AND c.id = b.wechat_channel_id LEFT JOIN wa_templates t ON t.org_id = b.org_id AND t.id = b.template_id WHERE b.org_id = $1 ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT $2
SELECT count(*)::int AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(group_code, $2) <> $3)::int AS coded FROM wa_groups WHERE org_id = $1

SELECT count(*)::int AS total, coalesce(sum(sent), $2)::int AS sent, coalesce(sum(failed), $3)::int AS failed, coalesce(sum(blocked), $4)::int AS blocked, coalesce(sum(total), $5)::int AS audience, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = $6)::int AS sending FROM telegram_broadcasts WHERE org_id = $1

SELECT to_char(date_trunc($1, i.issue_date::timestamp), $5) AS start, i.currency, coalesce(sum(i.total_minor), $6)::text AS total FROM invoices i WHERE i.org_id = $2 AND i.status = $7 AND i.doc_type <> $8 AND i.issue_date >= $3::date AND i.issue_date <= $4::date GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT r.id, r.uuid, r.peer_key, r.source, r.status, r.end_reason, r.failure_reason, r.halt_reason, r.current_node_id, r.started_at, r.last_activity_at, r.ended_at, r.resume_at, f.uuid AS flow_uuid, f.flow_name, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, c.name AS contact_name, ch.uuid AS channel_uuid, ch.name AS channel_name, ch.kind AS channel_kind, CASE WHEN r.node_count > $3 THEN r.node_count ELSE (SELECT count(*)::int FROM flow_run_steps s WHERE s.org_id = r.org_id AND s.run_id = r.id) END AS steps, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM flow_run_steps rs WHERE rs.org_id = r.org_id AND rs.run_id = r.id AND rs.event = $4) AS replies, r.node_count, r.error_count, r.duration_ms FROM flow_runs r JOIN flows f ON f.org_id = r.org_id AND f.id = r.flow_id LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = r.org_id AND c.id = r.contact_id LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.org_id = r.org_id AND ch.id = r.channel_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT CASE WHEN p.paid_at >= $1::timestamptz AND p.paid_at < $2::timestamptz THEN $8 ELSE $9 END AS win, p.currency, $10::text AS dim_key, $11::text AS dim_label, $12::text AS dim_id, round(coalesce(sum(p.amount_minor * $13::numeric) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = $14), $15))::text AS collected, round(coalesce(-sum(p.amount_minor * $16::numeric) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = $17), $18))::text AS refunded FROM payments p LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.org_id = p.org_id AND i.id = p.invoice_id WHERE p.org_id = $3 AND ((p.paid_at >= $4::timestamptz AND p.paid_at < $5::timestamptz) OR (p.paid_at >= $6::timestamptz AND p.paid_at < $7::timestamptz)) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

SELECT e.*, to_char(e.created_at AT TIME ZONE $3, $4) AS created_at_iso, to_char(e.received_at AT TIME ZONE $5, $6) AS received_at_iso, s.uuid AS source_uuid, s.name AS source_name, s.kind AS source_kind, s.status AS source_status, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, dl.uuid AS deal_uuid, f.channel AS fr_channel, f.status AS fr_status, f.reason AS fr_reason, f.due_at AS fr_due_at, f.sent_at AS fr_sent_at, f.attempts AS fr_attempts FROM lead_events e JOIN lead_sources s ON s.org_id = e.org_id AND s.id = e.source_id LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = e.org_id AND c.id = e.contact_id LEFT JOIN deals dl ON dl.org_id = e.org_id AND dl.id = e.deal_id LEFT JOIN lead_first_replies f ON f.org_id = e.org_id AND f.lead_event_id = e.id WHERE e.org_id = $1 ORDER BY e.received_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT $2
SELECT c.resolved_by AS user_id, count(*)::int AS n FROM conversations c WHERE c.org_id = $1 AND c.status = $3 AND c.resolved_at >= $2::timestamptz GROUP BY c.resolved_by

SELECT d.currency, count(*)::int AS n, sum(d.value_minor)::text AS total, coalesce(sum(extract($3 FROM (d.won_at - d.created_at)) / $4), $5)::float8 AS days_sum FROM deals d WHERE d.org_id = $1 AND d.status = $2 GROUP BY d.currency
UPDATE ONLY "public"."lead_first_replies" SET "contact_id" = $3 WHERE $1 OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) "org_id" AND $2 OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) "contact_id"

SELECT r.id, r.uuid, r.created_at, to_char(r.created_at at time zone $3, $4) AS created_at_iso, r.updated_at, r.name, r.status, r.frequency, r.interval_n, to_char(r.start_date, $5) AS start_date, to_char(r.end_date, $6) AS end_date, r.max_runs, r.mode, r.send_channel, r.template, r.contact_id, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, c.name AS contact_name, r.owner_id, r.created_by, r.next_index, to_char(r.next_run_date, $7) AS next_run_date, r.run_count, r.failure_count, r.last_run_at, r.row_version FROM recurring_invoices r LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = r.org_id AND c.id = r.contact_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.org_id = m.org_id AND c.id = m.conversation_id JOIN channels ch ON ch.org_id = c.org_id AND ch.id = c.channel_id WHERE m.org_id = $1 AND ch.kind = $4 AND m.direction = $5 AND m.kind <> $6 AND m.created_at >= $2::timestamptz AND m.created_at < $3::timestamptz

SELECT s.id, s.uuid, s.contact_id, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, c.name AS contact_name, s.from_stage, s.to_stage, s.confidence, s.reasons, s.status, s.source, s.created_at, s.decided_at FROM lifecycle_stage_suggestions s JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = s.org_id AND c.id = s.contact_id WHERE s.org_id = $1 AND s.status = $2 ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT $3

SELECT a.uuid, a.name, a.status, a.ai_model, (SELECT count(*) FROM ai_training_sources src WHERE src.org_id = a.org_id AND lower(src.status) = $2 AND src.assistant_id = a.id) AS sources FROM ai_chat_assistants a WHERE a.org_id = $1 ORDER BY a.name

SELECT r.id, r.uuid, r.peer_key, r.source, r.status, r.end_reason, r.failure_reason, r.halt_reason, r.current_node_id, r.started_at, r.last_activity_at, r.ended_at, r.resume_at, r.trigger_text, r.vars, r.wait, r.expires_at, COALESCE(r.graph, gv.graph) AS run_graph, CASE WHEN f.is_published AND f.published_flow_data IS NOT NULL THEN f.published_flow_data ELSE f.flow_data END AS current_flow_data, f.uuid AS flow_uuid, f.flow_name, c.uuid AS contact_uuid, c.name AS contact_name, ch.uuid AS channel_uuid, ch.name AS channel_name, ch.kind AS channel_kind, CASE WHEN r.node_count > $3 THEN r.node_count ELSE (SELECT count(*)::int FROM flow_run_steps s WHERE s.org_id = r.org_id AND s.run_id = r.id) END AS steps, r.node_count, r.error_count, r.duration_ms FROM flow_runs r JOIN flows f ON f.org_id = r.org_id AND f.id = r.flow_id LEFT JOIN flow_graph_versions gv ON gv.org_id = r.org_id AND gv.id = r.graph_version_id LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = r.org_id AND c.id = r.contact_id LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.org_id = r.org_id AND ch.id = r.channel_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND r.uuid = $2::uuid

SELECT f.*, to_char(f.created_at AT TIME ZONE $3, $4) AS created_at_iso, v.version AS published_version, v.published_at, (v.id IS NULL OR v.definition IS DISTINCT FROM f.draft_definition) AS has_unpublished_changes, (SELECT count(*) FROM web_form_events e WHERE e.org_id = f.org_id AND e.form_id = f.id AND e.kind = $5)::int AS views, (SELECT count(*) FROM web_form_submissions x WHERE x.org_id = f.org_id AND x.form_id = f.id AND x.status <> $6)::int AS submissions, (SELECT count(*) FROM web_form_submissions x WHERE x.org_id = f.org_id AND x.form_id = f.id AND x.status IN ($7, $8))::int AS needs_review, (SELECT max(x.created_at) FROM web_form_submissions x WHERE x.org_id = f.org_id AND x.form_id = f.id AND x.status <> $9) AS last_submission_at FROM web_forms f LEFT JOIN web_form_versions v ON v.org_id = f.org_id AND v.id = f.published_version_id WHERE f.org_id = $1 AND f.status <> $10 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT b.id, b.uuid, b.name, b.facebook_page_id, p.uuid AS page_uuid, p.name AS page_name, t.uuid AS template_uuid, b.body, b.buttons #>> $3 AS buttons, b.status, b.total, b.sent, b.failed, b.blocked, b.last_error, b.started_at, b.finished_at, b.created_at, b.row_version FROM facebook_broadcasts b JOIN facebook_pages p ON p.org_id = b.org_id AND p.id = b.facebook_page_id LEFT JOIN wa_templates t ON t.org_id = b.org_id AND t.id = b.template_id WHERE b.org_id = $1 ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT count(*)::int AS total, coalesce(sum(sent), $2)::int AS sent, coalesce(sum(failed), $3)::int AS failed, coalesce(sum(blocked), $4)::int AS blocked, coalesce(sum(total), $5)::int AS audience, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = $6)::int AS sending FROM line_broadcasts WHERE org_id = $1
SELECT * FROM conferencing_connections WHERE org_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 ORDER BY provider
DELETE FROM wa_customer_profiles WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid RETURNING id

select "id", "uuid", "type", "title", "body", "link", "data", "read_at", "created_at", "collapse_key", "event_count", "subject_kind", "subject_uuid" from "inbox_notifications" where ("inbox_notifications"."org_id" = $1 and "inbox_notifications"."user_id" = $2) order by "inbox_notifications"."id" desc limit $3
SELECT id, name, status FROM broadcasts WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid
SELECT provider, api_key FROM ai_provider_keys WHERE org_id = $1 AND is_active

SELECT id, uuid, type, direction, amount::text AS amount, balance_after::text AS balance_after, source, description, note, actor_type, actor_label, created_at FROM wallet_transactions WHERE org_id = $1 AND (unit = $2 OR (unit IS NULL AND $3 = $4)) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $5
SELECT $3 FROM invoices WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2::uuid FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id, s.uuid, to_char(s.created_at at time zone $3, $4) AS created_at_iso, s.name, s.description, s.color, s.visibility, (s.visibility = $5 AND EXISTS ( SELECT $6 FROM segment_shares sh WHERE sh.org_id = s.org_id AND sh.segment_id = s.id AND (sh.user_id = current_actor_id() OR sh.team_id IN (SELECT tm.team_id FROM team_members tm WHERE tm.org_id = s.org_id AND tm.user_id = current_actor_id())) )) AS shared_with_me, s.shares_rev, s.owner_id, u.uuid AS owner_uuid, u.full_name AS owner_name, cb.uuid AS created_by_uuid, cb.full_name AS created_by_name, ub.uuid AS updated_by_uuid, ub.full_name AS updated_by_name, s.rules, s.rules_version, s.member_count_cache, s.member_count_at, s.last_used_at, s.row_version, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM segments s LEFT JOIN users u ON u.org_id = s.org_id AND u.id = s.owner_id LEFT JOIN users cb ON cb.org_id = s.org_id AND cb.id = s.created_by LEFT JOIN users ub ON ub.org_id = s.org_id AND ub.id = s.updated_by WHERE s.org_id = $1 ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT currency FROM ( SELECT i.currency FROM invoices i WHERE i.org_id = $1 AND i.status = $3 AND i.doc_type <> $4 UNION SELECT p.currency FROM payments p LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.org_id = p.org_id AND i.id = p.invoice_id WHERE p.org_id = $2 ) c ORDER BY currency
SELECT coalesce(category, $2) AS category, count(*) AS n FROM flows WHERE org_id = $1 GROUP BY 1
SELECT min(category) AS category FROM saved_replies r WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND (r.user_id IS NULL OR r.user_id = $2) AND category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lower(category) ORDER BY lower(min(category))

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta_json->>'waba_id') meta_json->>$2 AS waba_id, phone_number, display_label FROM wa_provider_configs WHERE org_id = $1 AND provider = $3 AND status = $4 AND COALESCE(meta_json->>$5, $6) <> $7 ORDER BY meta_json->>'waba_id', id
SELECT id, uuid, full_name, email FROM users WHERE org_id = $1 AND uuid = $2 AND status = $3

SELECT bt.id AS type_id, count(DISTINCT a.id) AS total, count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.customer_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS confirmed, count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = $4) AS cancelled, count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = $5) AS no_show FROM appointment_reminder_runs r JOIN appointments a ON a.org_id = r.org_id AND a.id = r.appointment_id JOIN booking_types bt ON bt.org_id = a.org_id AND bt.id = a.booking_type_id WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND r.due_at >= $2 AND r.due_at < $3 AND r.status = $6 GROUP BY bt.id

SELECT uuid, name, color, member_count_cache FROM segments WHERE org_id = $1 AND (visibility = $5 OR owner_id = $2::bigint OR (visibility = $6 AND EXISTS ( SELECT $7 FROM segment_shares sh WHERE sh.org_id = segments.org_id AND sh.segment_id = segments.id AND (sh.user_id = $3::bigint OR sh.team_id IN (SELECT tm.team_id FROM team_members tm WHERE tm.org_id = segments.org_id AND tm.user_id = $4::bigint))))) ORDER BY lower(name), id

SELECT d.*, c.uuid AS contact_uuid FROM lead_chat_digests d JOIN contacts c ON c.org_id = d.org_id AND c.id = d.contact_id WHERE d.org_id = $1 AND c.uuid = $2::uuid ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT $3
SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock($1) AS ok

THEN m.meta ->> $39 WHEN m.sender_agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN $40 WHEN m.sender_kind = $41 OR m.meta ->> $42 = $43 THEN $44 ELSE $45 END AS source, m.direction AS direction, m.status AS status, CASE
